title: Vaccines work… and do not cause autism
content:
by Nonia Pariente

Vaccines have saved millions of lives, yet their importance and safety is repeatedly in question. We cannot let disinformation campaigns get in the way of global public health—it is not time to defund, but rather invest in these life-saving tools.
